shadows.name: shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: Objects rest on the paper like products on a catalogue table, lit from above.

shadows.name: shadow-key
shadows.value: inset top shine, 1px edge, 1.5px lip, 3px drop
shadows.purpose: Keycaps; the lip disappears as a key sinks.

shadows.name: knob-cast
shadows.value: contact, key light, and ambient shadows scaled to the knob
shadows.purpose: The knob stands on the receiver; turning presses it 1% into the panel.

motion.name: spring
motion.value: linear() damped spring, 6% overshoot; 240ms keys, 380ms knob, 1300ms needle
motion.purpose: One mechanical spring for everything physical.

motion.name: key-press
motion.purpose: Every key sinks under a press; the current section's key stays latched.

motion.name: knob-detents
motion.value: stiction 0.6 near each detent, about 7° give past the end stops, spring into the detent on release
motion.purpose: A steady drag reads as a click; an 8ms haptic tick per detent where supported.

motion.name: knob-sheen
motion.purpose: Spun metal's streak of light follows the viewer while the knob turns underneath it.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.value: masked disc from the knob with a band of concentric rings, 820ms, cubic-bezier(0.37, 0, 0.63, 1)
motion.purpose: A theme change spreads out from under the knob; otherwise a 240ms crossfade.

motion.name: power-on
motion.value: display segment test 700ms; needle tunes in from Monday over 1300ms
motion.purpose: Once per visit, skipped on anchor or history arrival.

motion.name: scale-tuning
motion.value: ghost needle under a mouse, day and station lit
motion.purpose: Mouse users can tune across the week.

motion.name: header-edge
motion.purpose: Confirms the sticky header is floating once the page has scrolled.

backdrops.name: sticky-header
backdrops.purpose: Separate pseudo-element layer keeps the keys readable; opaque fallback.

backdrops.name: window-glass
backdrops.value: inner shadow and a diagonal reflection
backdrops.purpose: The scale and the display sit behind glass.

display.purpose: Archivo 600, tightly tracked: the name, section titles, card titles.

body.purpose: Archivo 400 for prose and the About statement.

label.purpose: Archivo 500 at 11–13px: keys, labels, the scale, the knob's positions; tabular figures.

german.purpose: Archivo 500 in grey print beside each section title; decorative and aria-hidden.

components.name: Theme knob
components.description: Three radios (Light, Auto, Dark) drawn as a spun-aluminium knob with a knurled grip and an engraved orange indicator. Labels and arrow keys change the radios; a drag turns the knob through the detents; a tap advances one position. The theme spreads out from under the knob.
components.css: .ds-knob { position: relative; width: 112px; height: 112px; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .32), 0 10px 16px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / .22), 0 25px 34px -11px rgb(0 0 0 / .3); } .ds-knob span { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-grip { inset: 0; background: repeating-conic-gradient(#6f6f6c 0deg, #a4a4a1 .6deg, #fdfdfc 1.4deg, #d6d6d3 2.1deg, #6f6f6c 3deg); } .ds-face { inset: 12%; translate: 0 -2px; background: repeating-radial-gradient(circle, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 0 .5px, rgb(255 255 255 / .1) .8px, rgb(0 0 0 / .06) 1.3px, rgb(255 255 255 / 0) 1.8px), conic-gradient(from -40deg, #fdfdfc, #d6d6d3 26deg, #a4a4a1 62deg, #d6d6d3 96deg, #fdfdfc 130deg, #d6d6d3 150deg, #a4a4a1 176deg, #fdfdfc 180deg, #d6d6d3 206deg, #a4a4a1 242deg, #d6d6d3 276deg, #fdfdfc 310deg, #d6d6d3 330deg, #a4a4a1 354deg, #fdfdfc); } .ds-mark { left: 50%; top: 18%; width: 3px; height: 20%; translate: -50% -2px; border-radius: 2px; background: #e85a20; }

components.name: Push-button key
components.description: A 32px cap inside a 44px target. Pressing sinks it 1.5px and its lip disappears; the current section's key stays latched with a short orange lamp under its word.
components.css: .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: #faf9f6; color: #1a1a19; font: 500 13px Archivo, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .9), 0 0 0 1px #b3b1a9, 0 1.5px 0 1px #bebcb4; } .ds-key:active { translate: 0 1.5px; background: #e6e5df; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .16), 0 0 0 1px #b3b1a9; }

components.name: Receiver
components.description: The hero object: the week as a tuning scale behind black glass with a needle at now in Berlin, a seven-segment display of the Berlin clock, today's station, a punched speaker grille, and the theme knob.
components.css: .ds-receiver { padding: 20px; border-radius: 26px; background: #f4f3ef; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), 0 34px 54px -34px rgb(0 0 0 / .55); } .ds-window { position: relative; height: 72px; border-radius: 12px; background: #161615; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / .6); } .ds-needle { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 62%; width: 2px; background: #e85a20; }

narrative.northStar: One receiver on a catalogue page: less, but better
narrative.overview: A project-first homepage in the Braun register: warm grey paper, white and anthracite bodies, black print, one signal orange and one green pilot lamp. The one object is a receiver whose tuning scale is the real weekly schedule, whose needle and display follow the Berlin clock, and whose hyper-realistic knob switches the theme. Everything else is printed panels, a keypad, and a row of day slots. Controls behave like controls: keys sink and latch, panels lift, the knob clicks through detents.
keyCharacteristics: One signal orange for now and for action, one green pilot lamp, data in grey print
A receiver built from the schedule and the Berlin clock
A hyper-realistic spun-aluminium knob with detents, springs, and a sheen that follows the viewer
Push-button keys that sink and latch, panels that lift, one mechanical spring
Archivo alone, German sub-labels, no separators, always-visible keys

researchInterpretation.summary: The receiver, keys, grille, display, and knob are an original interpretation of Braun's design language under Dieter Rams and Dietrich Lubs: neutral bodies with one functional accent, lowercase-quiet printed legends, linear tuning scales with a red-orange pointer, punched speaker grilles, knurled aluminium knobs, and seven-segment displays. No Braun logo, product name, model number, or other mark is reproduced, and every instrument shows real data.

sources.title: Dieter Rams, Ten principles for good design
sources.role: Less, but better: one object, honest function, no decoration without purpose.

rules.name: The One-Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange means now or action; green means on. Nothing else has a hue.

rules.name: The Printed-Data Rule
rules.body: Recorded data is grey print, never a colour.

rules.name: The Pair Rule
rules.body: Every colour change comes with a shape change: a key sinks, a panel lifts, a lamp glows.

rules.name: The Physical-Light Rule
rules.body: Light comes from above; the knob's spun face keeps its highlight still while it turns, and the sheen follows the viewer.

rules.name: The Answer-or-Once Rule
rules.body: Every movement answers the reader or runs once per visit; nothing loops, blinks, or makes a sound.

rules.name: The Real-Data Rule
rules.body: Every instrument measures something real: the schedule, the Berlin clock, the real destinations.

dos: Do keep every control at a 44px target and give every press a physical answer.
Do keep orange for now and action, green for lamps, and data in grey print.
Do build instruments from real data.
Do run bun test after any token change; the contrast test measures both themes.
Do honour reduced motion, forced colours, reduced transparency, more contrast, and no-JavaScript reading.
donts: Don't reproduce the Braun logo, product names, model numbers, or other marks.
Don't add section numbers, separator lines, sliding indicators, or a custom logo.
Don't add a second accent, colour data, or put glow on text.
Don't loop, blink, play sounds, or invent readings for an instrument to show.
